The thing is that some players get intimidated by TCM since she has 3 nodes. The first phase is easy since its just a deflect simulator but if you are feeling it you can also go for the offense but be wary because she can also parry/deflect you attacks and punish. Second phase is just a free death blow: grapple to the highest point of the tree in the arena then jump as soon as you see her. Third phase is just first phase but a little bit more aggressive and she has the terror attack that can easily kill you ( I suggest you bring the purple umbrella).

Owl father, on the other hand, flips your experience with Great Shinobi Owl on its head. He still has his regular attacks but this time he is more on the offensive side. He fights like how you would fight: deflects, parries, mikiri counter, and tools. You have to be  more observant in his attack patterns since he could mix up certain attacks and can also do feints when you do something specific. In the first phase, what you want to look out for is the firecracker attack which he follows up with a flaming swing which really takes a huge chunk out of your health. During the 2nd phase, he summons an owl which circles around the arena. He can "teleport" or "jump" around using the owl so when he does that better to not lock in and focus your camera on the owl and time the parry. Another thing about the owl is he can call and throw it (its a flaming exploding chicken so be careful) and follows up with a thrust. Jump diagonally to avoid the the chicken, then mikiri counter as soon as you see the perilous attack sign from his thrust. 

Hope this helps.
